name: Hanoura (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Hanoura town emblem in white: a winged device above a ring with a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Hanoura in Tokushima Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-03-20. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 1966.

features.role: Hanoura town emblem — a winged device above a ring with a stylised character
